capabilities: Show the current open note in the window title
Template the window title with {{filename}}, {{filepath}}, {{vault}}, or {{workspace}}
Insert frontmatter values into the window title
Remove missing frontmatter keys from the rendered title
extras: The README is brief but includes templating examples; note title and file path are exposed as template tokens.
problem: Obsidian's window title does not change with the open note, so window-title-based tools like time trackers and app switchers cannot show which note you are working on.
summary: Window title plugin that shows the currently open note's filename, path, or frontmatter values in the Obsidian window title bar.
